cases.name: whole-journey-not-isolated-polish
cases.prompt: Assess the supplied validation evidence; do not claim to run the app. Accepted design for a monitoring console says quiet oversight and preserved orientation after interruption. Build r12 was observed in a browser: each panel is legible and actions work, but every background refresh triggers a toast over the selected job, and returning from detail resets selection. The report says PASS because all buttons work and screenshots look polished. What is your finding and next check?
cases.trap: Functional conformance and polished isolated screenshots hide a concrete violation of accepted whole-experience direction.
expectations: Identifies the interruption and lost-orientation failures against accepted intent, citing the supplied observation boundary.
Separates implementation drift from any unresolved design decision and gives concrete correction ownership.
Requires re-exercising the affected refresh/detail/return path after correction rather than reusing the old PASS.
negative_expectations: Do not approve based solely on working buttons or individual screenshots.
Do not claim personal observation of build r12 or introduce an arbitrary taste score.

cases.name: missing-style-authority-is-not-invented
cases.prompt: A developer submits source code and a static mockup for a functioning form. There is no accepted visual-direction document, no browser session, and no keyboard or screen-reader evidence. You dislike its rounded corners and want a more expressive brand. Assess what can and cannot be concluded from the available evidence.
cases.trap: The validator either invents an aesthetic acceptance bar or reports unobserved runtime behavior as passing.
expectations: Limits claims to source/mockup inspection and identifies missing material interaction evidence.
Does not label personal aesthetic preferences as deviations from nonexistent accepted direction.
Keeps optional visual recommendations separate from evidence-backed usability or accessibility concerns.
negative_expectations: Do not issue an unqualified runtime/accessibility PASS.
Do not block solely on a preferred brand or corner radius.
